        'path': parsed.path,
        'params': parsed.params,
        'query': parsed.query,
        'fragment': parsed.fragment,
    }


def _format_url(components: Dict[str, str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Reconstruct a URL from its components."""
    if not components['netloc']:
        return None
    
    parts = [
        components.get('scheme', ''),
        components['netloc'],
        components['path'],
        '',  # params
        components['query'],
        components.get('fragment', ''),
    ]
    
    reconstructed = urlunparse(parts)
    return reconstructed if reconstructed else None
